title: Scope pipeline log to CSV rerun
summary: Scoped active CSV rerun diagnostics snapshots to rerun-owned log evidence. When child rerun progress is active but the child pipeline log is absent or empty, the backend now uses the active rerun process stdout/stderr tail instead of the operator/global pipeline_debug.log.
reason: The floating/native Pipeline Log activity view is powered by /api/diagnostics. CSV rerun progress could already come from the child runtime, but log_tail fell back to the global pipeline log when the child log was not ready, which surfaced unrelated library scan SKIP entries during CSV reruns.
behavior_before: Active CSV rerun child progress could be shown with a global pipeline log tail if the child pipeline_debug.log was missing, empty, or not flushed yet.
behavior_after: Active CSV rerun child progress emits a scoped log tail from the child pipeline log or the active rerun process stdout/stderr; if neither exists, it reports that no CSV rerun tail is ready instead of showing unrelated global log lines.
rollback_plan: Revert src/mediapipeline/core/status/rerun_progress.py and tests/python/desktop/test_service_status_snapshot_runner.py to restore prior global log fallback behavior.
notes:
Cover CSV rerun diagnostics log-tail scoping when child progress is active but child log is not ready.
Prefer scoped active CSV rerun child/process log tails in status snapshots before emitting any fallback message.
Refresh summary after rerun progress log-tail source change.
Refresh summary after adding CSV rerun diagnostics log scoping test.
Add generated summary for the change packet.
